Subject: Private offer request and payment timing question

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for a great demo earlier today. Procurement here — a couple of quick asks so we can move to a PO: will Redwood accept Net90 on the private offer and can you confirm the marketplace rev-share split? Our CFO is pushing for extended payment terms to better align cash flows with customers. We can take a 12-month commit.

High level ask: 10% introductory discount + Net90. Also looking to see if Redwood will accept a 70/30 rev-share split for the first 6 months (we can transition to standard split thereafter).

Attached is the SOW and our internal pricing model (for context). Please advise next steps and whether exec approval is needed.

Regards,
Lara Chen

procurement@nimbusdata.com

Karthik / Vanessa — forwarding a procurement ask from Nimbus (attached). They want: 10% one-time discount, Net90 payment, and an initial 70/30 rev-share in their favor for six months before reverting to standard. They have a 12-month commit and appear to be a strategic win (edge infra customer).

I think the material items are:
- Payment terms (Net90) — finance impact / credit risk?
- Rev-share 70/30 carveout for first 6 months — revenue recognition and partner/marketplace implications
- One-time 10% discount applied to first invoice or a rebate?

Can you advise: do we need exec approval to sign this private offer with these deviations? If so, can we get a short approval memo? Also tagging Evelyn for visibility on strategic fit.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call.

Best,

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:05:00 -0500

Thanks for the context, Mateo. I reviewed the attachments. Quick assessment:
- Net90 is outside our standard marketplace terms. Finance will want an ARR-backed commit or a credit check + cap.
- 70/30 rev-share in favor of Nimbus is a significant gateway; marketplace ops will flag this for gross-to-net treatment.
- 10% discount is modest but combined with rev-share and Net90 becomes material.

Recommended path:
1) Vanessa: can finance run a quick risk / working capital impact calc (attach expected cashflow schedule from pricing_model)? Suggest requiring a bank guarantee or pre-approved credit line if Net90 is approved.
2) I will draft an exec exception memo we can circulate to Revenue Ops & Legal outlining a time-boxed exception: 6 months rev-share transition, Net90 limited to 1 invoice only (first month), and discount applied as a one-time credit on invoice #1. Also propose a $200k cap on deferred receivables.
3) If Revenue Ops / Finance and Legal sign off, request Evelyn for final exec sign-off (given strategic priority).

Mateo — please confirm total ARR commit ($ value) and if they will accept the cap / guarantee ask.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 11:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request and payment timing question

I ran a quick modeling exercise (see attached pricing_model_nimbus.xlsx). Short answer: Net90 across the board increases our DSO impact materially. I can approve Net90 ONLY if:
- We get a bank guarantee or letter of credit covering the Net90 exposure up to the $200k cap Karthik proposed, AND
- Nimbus signs a short amendment acknowledging accelerated collection rights if payments are late, AND
- The contract includes a milestone clause where failure to meet usage thresholds voids the extended term for upcoming invoices.

On the 70/30 rev-share: Revenue Ops will not accept a permanent 70/30 split. A time-boxed, measured ramp (70/30 for first 60 days with measurable usage gates and then revert to 85/15) might be acceptable. Legal will want to see the marketplace listing and confirm netting treatment with AWS Ops.

If Nimbus agrees to the bank guarantee + milestones, I can sign off and loop in Finance Ops to update billing. If not, we should push for Net45 and a small prepayment.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Lead, Commercial Deals | Redwood Inference
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 15:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request and payment timing question

All — I’ve reviewed the proposed exception language and the finance calc. I approve the exception on the following conditions:
1) Net90 allowed for first invoice only and only with a bank guarantee covering up to $200k of exposure. If bank guarantee isn’t acceptable, Net45 with a 25% upfront payment.
2) Rev-share: accept temporary 70/30 in favor of Nimbus for first 60 days only, contingent on usage >= X units (defined in SOW). After 60 days revert to standard 85/15.
3) 10% discount to be delivered as a one-time invoice credit on invoice 1; no ongoing price change.
4) Legal to insert milestone & audit clause; Revenue Ops to confirm marketplace accounting and ensure AWS Private Offer listing mirrors these terms.
5) This exception is authorized for this single deal (ND-2028-0345) and expires if the contract is not executed within 30 days.

Karthik — please prepare the formal exception memo summarizing the conditions and route to Legal/Revenue Ops/AWS Ops. Mateo — share this conditional approval with the customer and ask them to confirm acceptance of bank guarantee + timeline.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Global Sales | Redwood Inference
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Lara Chen <procurement@nimbusdata.com>

Lara — thanks for the request and for sending the SOW. Quick update from Redwood: we can approve the private offer with the following conditions (executive exception granted):
- Payment terms: Net90 for invoice 1 only, contingent on a bank guarantee (or letter of credit) covering up to $200,000. If a bank guarantee is not available, we can move to Net45 + 25% upfront.
- Rev-share: temporary 70/30 in your favor for the first 60 days only, contingent on meeting the usage milestones in the attached SOW. After 60 days the split will revert to standard 85/15.
- Discount: 10% one-time credit applied to invoice 1 only.
- Execution window: agreement must be signed within 30 days of this approval.

Please confirm if Nimbus can provide the bank guarantee and accept the milestone language. Once you confirm, we will prepare the AWS Private Offer draft and route to AWS Marketplace Ops for listing. I’ve cc’ed AWS Ops so they have visibility into the temporary split and Net90 ask.

If you prefer a short call to go through the conditions, I’m available tomorrow morning PST.

Best,
